corrections: C1 (whole file) The research scored against an 18:32 copy of glue/server/lorerim_glue/lib. The build team has since landed 'pt19c-A fix 1' (54 tagged edits, lrg_dialogue.php 372 KB -> 403 KB). The changes that matter here are the WordsCarry precision rail on the fast path, LeadsQuestion over unfolded tokens, token-aligned containment, content outranking the refusal regex, and new assent idioms (let's go, no problem, why not). All 2,943 utterances were re-scored against a 19:13 read-only snapshot. Each changed paraphrase, STT variant and near-miss now carries changed_by_verify, with the researcher's value kept in *_research. Verdicts: say 1,695 resolve->resolve and 206 ask->ask agree; 25 say nothing->resolve, 8 say nothing->ask, 3 say resolve->ask, 17 STT verdicts moved, and 47 near-miss verdicts moved (20 ask->nothing, 25 resolve->nothing, 2 nothing->resolve/advance).

C2 (gap 2) Loose paraphrases now depend on the model MORE than reported. 780 of 2,616 say/STT utterances on 226 beats (29.8%, not 17%) are resolved only by the model's T-key. 416 of them had a rule route in the research and lost it. 390 were removed by the new precision rail (lrgDlgWordsCarry: shared strict words / his strict words >= 0.75), because any extra meaning word ('lizard', 'shall', 'back', 'from') now blocks the fast pick. Example: 'I shall buy back the gem for a thousand gold.' was a fast pick and is now model-only.
C3 (gap 13) FIXED in the current lib. lrgDlgLeadsQuestion now reads unfolded tokens, so "we're out of patience" no longer reads as a question. It releases 021E86 at step 4 (0.838).

C4 (gap 4, agreeing replies refused) Partly stale. Karliah's 'Hold on... you shot me!' (01BB45) now releases verbatim (2 exact 1.0), because content outranks the refusal regex. The STT variant 'hold on you shut me' now auto-advances. 'stop him' (037CD8), 'pay up and I'll forget it' (029726), 'I won't kill you' and 'not our way' (0D771D) are still refused at step 0.

C5 (gap 1 numbers) On the current lib 27 question near-misses (not 31) click the target on the fast path. The claim '20 more park on a line the player never asked for' is wrong for the fast path: lrgDlgAnswerWant never parks. Those 20 commit matches return nothing there, and a park happens only if the model itself T-keys the line. Each of these near-misses now carries if_the_model_keys_it. In total 35 near-misses click their target (27 of them questions), 9+2 advance by design on unscripted singles, and 69 click a sibling.

C6 (md gap 14, 'one wrong-entry hit') Stale. 'I nearly died getting here' no longer lands on 'Getting here was easy.': the precision rail stops it (0.721, precision < 0.75). The model decides, and a T-key on the target parks it.

C7 TG04Post.tonilia.sure (0D3AB5) path ask_once -> pick. Its layer ['Yes, I'm sure.', 'Actually, let me chose something else.'] is the engine's own confirmation (lrgDlgLayerIsOwnConfirmation true), so lrgDlgParkOrRelease releases at once. The research's own vias already said 'own confirmation'.
C8 TG08A.karliah.ready (05A0C0) driven_as ask_once -> pick, stageB pick. Its layer ['I'm not sure I understand the terms.', 'Yes, I'm ready.'] is an own-confirmation layer.

C9 TG07.karliah.ready (055AA0) is ask_once only on the first 3-entry layer (parent 055AA3). After 'What if Mercer's there?' (parent 055A9F) the same line sits with 'No, I'm not.' on an own-confirmation layer, where it is a pick.

C10 TG07.vex.buyoff (072AF9) and TGCrown.vex.buy (09DFB5) are class service ('buy'). lrgDlgSingleEntryOf accepts only plain/commit, so they are NOT S4.5 single-entry layers: no single release, no step 0, no auto-advance. They go through the similarity path plus the precision rail, or a T-key. Their 'single (...)' vias were wrong. 'pay him off?' (0.783) no longer clicks on the fast path (precision 0.5), and fixture_expect is pick.

C11 (cannot) TG08B.karliah.intro (039E36) and TG08B.karliah.outro (03A065) path cannot -> open. They are EditorID-text top-level branches (no prompt text, scripted, NPC line first). No one can pick them, but the conversation open plays them, whether that is the E-press or the glue's pre-LLM open (S2). They are reachable by voice only through the open. The same holds for the missed Mercer opener 038A3C, which was added.

C12 (fixture form, 3.3) 98 single-entry beats had no parent_info, although 3.3 requires the parent form for single layers. It was filled from the index: the player row whose links reach the target topic, with covered rows preferred and alternatives listed. 22 greeting-opened singles have no player parent (gap 7) and are marked fixture_form. 7 closed layers were synthesized from links because the index has no layer line: TG04Post.tonilia.sure, TGR.vex.shill.accept, TGCSG.sell.do and the four TGTQ01.rhorlak.* beats. The harness refuses those; they are marked NOT EXPRESSIBLE until the builder emits a layer line.

C13 (fixture vocabulary) The research paths (pick/ask_once/...) are not the 3.3 expect words. Every beat now carries fixture_expect (pick | explicit | park | single | auto | check | pay | open | none | scene) plus stageB on scene beats. The mapping is: an unscripted single is auto (adv=2500); a scripted or commit single is single; a commit on its own-confirmation layer is pick; any other commit is explicit when its verbatim line is explicit, otherwise park.

C14 (STT style) The STT variants are not in the owner's measured style. 217 of 654 are just the line lower-cased without punctuation, which lrgPromptNorm makes identical to the verbatim line, so they test nothing. Only 8 are first-word cuts and 14 last-word cuts. Those two are the owner's real parakeet failures (research/pt15-stt.md: 'Up man, I was looking to join the Legion', 'Like to take guard duty', 'train me in Smith'). Many are multi-token splits parakeet seldom emits ('brin yolf', 'in formation', 'hand all', 're quest', 'all most'); the owner's name damage is one non-English token ('lazette'), which lrg_stt.php's name fixer repairs when the named NPC is present. Added: stt_owner per beat, with a first-word-dropped and a last-word-cut variant for every line of 3+ words, scored. First cut: 271 resolve, 24 model, 2 re-arm, 1 advance, 7 ask, 3 nothing. Last cut: 263 resolve, 27 model, 16 ask, 1 nothing, 1 advance. A first-word cut turns 'He wasn't there, but I found these plans.' and 'Here's what they owed us.' into shape-refused lines ('wasn't there...' and 'what they owed us.' lead with a question word).

C15 TGR.delvin.*.accept (e.g. 0618CB 'I'll do it.'): 'sure, I'll do it', 'I'll do it then' and 'yeah, uh, I'll do it' are no longer explicit. The current lrgDlgExplicit makes an entry with no strict meaning word explicit only when said exactly, so these park and 'yes' releases them. C16 TG08A.karliah.letsgo and TG08B.karliah.ready: STT 'lets go' and 'i'm ready lets go' now release at step 1. "let's go" was added to confirm.assent_words.

method.matcher: real lrgDlgMatchText / lrgDlgMatchPick / lrgDlgUniqueWordTie / lrgDlgNegationClash / lrgDlgExplicit / lrgDlgSingleEntryRelease / lrgDlgAdvMs / lrgDlgClass / lrgDlgIsCommit from a read-only copy of glue/server/lorerim_glue/lib (2026-09-24), config lrg_config.default.json
method.layer: closed: the index layer line of parent_info (real sibling set); single: the target alone; root: a plausible subset of the NPC's top-level rows (+ DialogueGeneric "What have you got for sale?" 08069D where a merchant)
method.expect: want=1 fast path as lrgDlgAnswerWant runs it; when it picks nothing the model's T-key route is assumed (model_dependent=true). resolve = the target is clicked (fast, explicit, single, auto, T-key); ask = the commit parks and she asks quoting the line ("yes" then releases); nothing = no click (refusal, negation clash, check rail, shape, or a wrong entry)
method.score: lrgDlgMatchText eff score of the utterance against the target alone; top_score/margin = the same utterance against the whole layer
method.scene: scene=true means engine-opened with an unfinished journal objective (spec S0.5): read-only until this install's first proven click; paths show driven_as for after that
method.paths: pick | ask_once | scripted_entry_candidate | check | scene_read_only | service | cannot (spec S4/S5 rules, class from lrgDlgClass)
